_appid: Skip Steam: PS4 exclusive with no PC release; the artifact is the issn_pc community port bundled with a PS4 dump.
description: inFAMOUS Second Son (Sucker Punch Productions 2014 PS4 open-world superhero action in a locked-down Seattle, via the issn_pc 0.3.7 GPL community port: shadPS4-derived Vulkan 1.3 core running a PS4 1.07 dump through Proton)
long: inFAMOUS Second Son is the 2014 PlayStation 4 open-world action game from Sucker Punch Productions: in a locked-down Seattle, Delsin Rowe absorbs smoke, neon and video powers and turns them on the Department of Unified Protection. This package plays it through issn_pc, a GPL-licensed community Windows port whose shadPS4-derived Vulkan core runs a PlayStation 4 dump of the game.
name: inFAMOUS: Second Son
short: Delsin Rowe turns smoke, neon and video powers on the Department of Unified Protection in a locked-down Seattle (Sucker Punch 2014, via the issn_pc community port of a PS4 dump)
